info.description: Portfolio ecommerce API backed by PostgreSQL. Public catalog reads use GBP decimal prices. Product writes require an active admin. Register a customer, then use Authorize with your email in the username field to obtain a bearer token. Admin bootstrap is an operator CLI, never a public endpoint. Signed-in carts use current prices without reserving stock. Order placement claims stock; configured sandbox orders use hosted Checkout.
info.title: E-Commerce API
